claim.quote: The first result of the dark matter direct search experiment named InDEx with tetra-fluoro-ethane active liquid from JUSL underground laboratory is reported in this article.

name: First result from tetrafluoroethane (C$_2$H$_2$F$_4$) superheated emulsion detector for dark matter search at JUSL

summary.plain: InDEx's first run, with a small droplet detector, saw no dark matter and reported how sensitive it was to WIMPs of around 20-30 GeV.
summary.technical: 500 ml C2H2F4 detector, effective 48.6 days at a 5.87 keV threshold, exposure 2.47 kg-days; minimum sensitivity for SI-nucleon on carbon at 22.81 GeV/c^2 and SD (p) on fluorine at 30.67 GeV/c^2; WIMP mass threshold 5.16 GeV/c^2 (F) and 4.44 GeV/c^2 (C).

title: First result from tetrafluoroethane (C$_2$H$_2$F$_4$) superheated emulsion detector for dark matter search at JUSL
why_it_matters: First result from an Indian underground dark matter direct search.
